headline: Nigeria Currency Held Outside Banks Rises 104 Percent in Three Years
summary: Data from the Central Bank of Nigeria shows that currency held outside the banking system surged by 103.8 percent to N4.923 trillion in September 2026 compared to September 2023.
why: A high volume of cash circulating outside the formal banking sector can impede monetary policy transmission and reflect lingering public mistrust or structural liquidity preferences.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Persistent physical cash preference highlights challenges for formal banking sector deposit mobilization.
